rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm so glad you asked about the meeting. Have some tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing you need to worry about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who was there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely people. More tea?

card.title: Warmly Withholding
card.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I'll explain the missing parcel. Sit comfortably.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Somewhere being handled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: By whom?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone. You're very welcome to another biscuit.

card.title: Warmly Withholding
card.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One useful name costs one useful truth from you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You already know the answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you know the product exists.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll tell you who called.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. That buys the surname.

card.title: Secrets Have Value
card.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I admitted taking the key. Your turn to offer a secret.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Honesty shouldn't have a price.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The first sentence was complimentary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What about the rest?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can discuss a subscription.

card.title: Secrets Have Value
card.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told you where I was. You never asked what I carried.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An excellent new question.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Answer it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Notice how precise questions improve honesty.

card.title: I Told You Enough
card.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I promised honest answers, not a complete account.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's misleading.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if you stop asking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who was with you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you like the arrival list or the departure list?

card.title: I Told You Enough
card.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The receipt's missing. Somebody else is helping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It probably fell out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An unwitnessed disappearance. They're improving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody else is involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A very coordinated refusal to name them.

card.title: The Conspiracy Expands
card.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You and the manager gave the same answer. Rehearsed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Because it's true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the cover story's reached management.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There is no cover story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now it has a denial protocol.

card.title: The Conspiracy Expands
card.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass the talking cupboard a napkin. Let's make dinner normal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't have a lap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put it beside the handle, like a considerate host.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should I offer it soup?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We're getting the hang of ordinary hospitality.

card.title: Help Me Make This Normal
card.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say hello to the invisible guest without staring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at the chair. That's where visible guests usually begin.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good start. Ask whether the guest wants the window open.

card.title: Help Me Make This Normal
card.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't leave while the prophecy still says a visitor before sunset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun's set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here. We haven't settled the relevant time zone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay while we agree whether visitor includes the post.

card.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
card.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your coat off until the predicted bell rings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There is no bell here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then disproving the prophecy requires a properly documented absence of bells.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can write that now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Date it before departure becomes part of the prophecy.

card.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
card.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Apologise to the chair. You sat before it agreed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then a brief apology should be easy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For what? Furniture appreciates specificity.

card.title: Apologize to Reality
card.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the doorway you're sorry before trying the handle again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Doors don't hold grudges.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. This should clear up quickly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry I slammed you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now ask whether it's ready for visitors.

card.title: Apologize to Reality
card.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approve storing Tuesday's rain in this cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tuesday hasn't happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which is why we have room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happens if it overflows?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll borrow a saucer from Wednesday. Sign here.

card.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
card.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign off on the invisible landing before we build the stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No visible defects. An excellent inspection result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we stand on it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With confidence included in the materials budget.

card.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
card.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fold the moon; I'll stack these chairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the crescent. It already suggests a crease.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you get chairs?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone must keep the achievable work moving.

card.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
card.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yesterday's missing hour in this jar before lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Time doesn't fit in jars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then loosen the lid. Don't make the opening smaller than necessary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You do it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm labelling. We mustn't confuse it with tomorrow.

card.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
card.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What keeps the soup inside that upside-down bowl?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've never seen it either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then turn the spoon over. Let's test which thing owns down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The soup followed the spoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it over the sink while we learn the next rule.

card.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
card.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was walking slowly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop completely. Let's see whether it waits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's heading for the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then destination outranks speed. Follow without changing anything else.

card.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
card.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.
